channel.title: InvestPR Media Monitoring
channel.description: This period's wins center on hospitality and industrial investment: Prisa Group opened a $77M Hilton dual-brand hotel in the Convention District, Hilton plans nine more Puerto Rico hotels, and Toyota announced a $55M Toa Baja expansion. Other positives include a $2B Cabo Rojo development approved for Reuben Brothers and Three Rules Capital, Energy Bureau approval of the 80 MW Montalva solar and storage project, Accelerant's new international reinsurer license, and record bank earnings. Real risks are the New Fortress Energy LNG shortfall forcing diesel burning while the government talks to Crowley and Naturgy, the Yum! Brands exit that closed KFC and Taco Bell, higher electricity costs for businesses, and Oversight Board forecasts of contraction through 2028. The DDEC economic activity index shows modest growth, while manufacturing PMI fell to its lowest level in nearly two years.
